title: Advice to Singaporeans Working in Hong Kong Given Recent Street Protests There
what_it_is: Advice to Singaporeans Working in Hong Kong Given Recent Street Protests There

sections.label: MFA advice to Singaporeans in Hong Kong
sections.summary: MFA advises Singaporeans to avoid protest areas in Hong Kong, take precautions, stay vigilant, observe local laws and monitor developments, noting over 15,000 Singaporeans reside there.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) has advised Singaporeans to avoid areas where protests are expected to take place.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Singaporeans must be mindful that protests which are meant to be peaceful may turn violent with little or no notice.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Singaporeans who are residing in or visiting Hong Kong should take the necessary precautions, stay vigilant, observe local laws and monitor developments through the local media and regular updates from the Singapore Consulate-General in Hong Kong.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We estimate that there are over 15,000 Singaporeans residing in Hong Kong.

sections.label: Singaporeans in Hong Kong e-registration
sections.summary: No Singaporeans are known to be directly affected or injured; about 3,000 e-registered, usually one-fifth of those there, and MFA does not track their activities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Because a lot of the local demonstrators emanated from the educational institutions there.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: So far, we are not aware of any Singaporeans who have been directly affected or injured.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Of about 3,000 Singaporeans who have e-registered, it is usually about one-fifth of those who are there.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We do not keep track of their activities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The purpose of e-registration is simply to enable us to be able to reach out to them if we need to provide updated information or for them to seek assistance from MFA.
